::: {.key-question}
What external factors influence health and wellbeing for Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people and families in the NEPHU catchment, including in supporting children and strong families?
:::

## All Presentations

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ED presentations - all presentations
# Data from PHIDU Social Health Atlas
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in PHIDU data
emergency_total <- f_read_phidu_iare_hospital(data_sheet    = "ED_total",
                                              column_select = "emergency_department_presentations_total_presentations_aboriginal_people")

# Data wrangling
emergency_total <- emergency_total %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(iare_name = factor(iare_name, levels = iare_inc_vic_lvl)) %>%
  #
  dplyr::arrange(iare_name)
```

- Data for this topic were obtained from the [PHIDU Social Health Atlas](https://phidu.torrens.edu.au/social-health-atlases), compiled from the [AIHW National Non-Admitted Patient Emergency Department Care Database (NNAPEDCD)](https://www.aihw.gov.au/reports/hospitals/non-admitted-patient-emergency-dept-care-nmds/summary).

- Between 01 July 2019 and 30 June 2020 there were 14,308 emergency department presentations for Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people living in Greater Melbourne.

- The number of emergency department presentations for Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people living in different IAREs within the NEPHU catchment ranged from 2,098 (Northcote/Preston/Whittlesea IARE) to 175 (Whitehorse IARE).

- The age-standardised rate of emergency department presentations for Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people living in different IAREs within the NEPHU catchment ranged from 57,485 per 100,000 population (Melbourne/Port Phillip IARE) to 33,003 per 100,000 population (Melbourne East IARE).

- 4 of the 10 IAREs in the NEPHU catchment area had an age-standardised rate of emergency department presentations above the average rate for all Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people living in Greater Melbourne (Melbourne/Port Phillip, Northcote/Preston/Whittlesea, Melbourne North-East, and Moreland/Broadmeadows IAREs).

::: {.callout-tip title="Definitions and notes about this topic" icon=false collapse=false}

#### `r figtab_figure_title`

::: {.fig-tab-title}
**`r figtab_figure_title`:** Number and age-standardised rate (per 100,000 population) of emergency department presentations for people who identified as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander, `r note_geography_nephu`, by `r note_comparison_iare`, `r note_time_emergency`
:::

```{r}
#
figure_number <- emergency_total %>% 
  f_bar_simple_iare(y_variable = aboriginal_n,
                    hospital   = "emergency")

figure_percent <- emergency_total %>% 
  f_bar_simple_iare(y_variable = aboriginal_rate,
                    hospital   = "emergency")

f_bar_simple_combine(figure_number, figure_percent)
```


```{r}
#
figtab_table_count  <- figtab_table_count + 1
figtab_table_title  <- paste0("Table", " ", figtab_report_section, "-", figtab_table_count)
figtab_table_number <- paste0("Table_", figtab_csv_section, "_", sprintf("%.02d", figtab_table_count))
```

#### `r figtab_table_title`

::: {.fig-tab-title}
**`r figtab_table_title`:** Emergency department presentations for people who identified as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander, `r note_geography_nephu`, by `r note_comparison_iare`, `r note_time_emergency`
:::

```{r}
#
table <- emergency_total %>%
  dplyr::select(-iare_name_short)

if (!file.exists(paste0(here::here(), "/data/", figtab_table_number, ".csv"))) {
  
  write.csv(table, paste0(here::here(), "/data/", figtab_table_number, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
}

table %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(aboriginal_rate = round(aboriginal_rate, digits = 0),
                hospital_ratio  = round(hospital_ratio, digits = 0)) %>% 
  #
  f_table_simple(iare     = "yes",
                 hospital = "emergency")
```

## Urgent Presentations

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ED presentations - urgent presentations
# Data from PHIDU Social Health Atlas
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in PHIDU data
emergency_urgent <- f_read_phidu_iare_hospital(data_sheet    = "ED_urgent",
                                               column_select = "emergency_department_presentations_total_urgent_presentations_aboriginal_people")

# Data wrangling
emergency_urgent <- emergency_urgent %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(iare_name = factor(iare_name, levels = iare_inc_vic_lvl)) %>%
  #
  dplyr::arrange(iare_name)
```

- Data for this topic were obtained from the [PHIDU Social Health Atlas](https://phidu.torrens.edu.au/social-health-atlases), compiled from the [AIHW National Non-Admitted Patient Emergency Department Care Database (NNAPEDCD)](https://www.aihw.gov.au/reports/hospitals/non-admitted-patient-emergency-dept-care-nmds/summary).

- Between 01 July 2019 and 30 June 2020 there were 6,139 urgent emergency department presentations for Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people living in Greater Melbourne. Urgent emergency presentations are defined as those with a triage category of urgent (requiring treatment within 30 minutes of arrival).

- The number of urgent emergency department presentations for Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people living in different IAREs within the NEPHU catchment ranged from 954 (Northcote/Preston/Whittlesea IARE) to 90 (Whitehorse IARE).

- The age-standardised rate of urgent emergency department presentations for Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people living in different IAREs within the NEPHU catchment ranged from 25,679 per 100,000 population (Melbourne/Port Phillip IARE) to 14,616 per 100,000 population (Melbourne East IARE).

- 4 of the 10 IAREs in the NEPHU catchment area had an age-standardised rate of urgent emergency department presentations above the average rate for all Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people living in Greater Melbourne (Melbourne/Port Phillip, Northcote/Preston/Whittlesea, Melbourne North-East, and Moreland/Broadmeadows IAREs).

::: {.callout-tip title="Definitions and notes about this topic" icon=false collapse=false}
